description:
Experience the next level of comfort and convenience with the 2025 Simple Step-Thru Hybrid Electric Bike. Designed with the lowest possible step-thru height, this bike makes mounting and dismounting effortless—no more awkward leg swings or unnecessary risks of tipping over. The forward pedal design, with pedals positioned approximately four inches forward from a traditional bike frame, allows you to keep your seat low while still achieving optimal leg extension, making every ride smooth and efficient.

NEW for 2025 – Ride Smoother Than Ever

The all-new front suspension fork takes your riding experience to the next level. Whether you're cruising over city streets, tackling hard-packed trails, or rolling over bumps in the road, this upgraded feature absorbs shocks and vibrations, ensuring a buttery-smooth and more comfortable ride. Say goodbye to jarring impacts and hello to effortless gliding.

Bigger, Better Display – Your Ride, At a Glance

Stay in control and informed with the brand-new, larger display. Offering crisp visibility in all lighting conditions, this enhanced screen makes it easier than ever to track your speed, battery life, pedal assist level, and more at a quick glance. Whether you're commuting, exploring, or enjoying a leisurely ride, all the essential information is right at your fingertips.

Effortless Power & Confidence on Every Ride

500-Watt Motor – Enjoy smooth acceleration with pedal assist or full-electric mode.

Top Speed of 20 mph – Reach speeds of 20 mph in both pedal-assist and full-electric mode.

500-Watt Hour Battery – Ride up to 20 miles on full electric or 20-40 miles with pedal assist on a single charge.

Front & Rear Disc Brakes – Powerful, reliable stopping power for enhanced safety.

Thicker Tires for Stability – Added stability, improved grip, and better shock absorption to keep you steady on any terrain.

Ergonomic Design for Pain-Free Rides

The upright, ergonomic riding position helps relieve pressure on your wrists, shoulders, back, and knees, so you can enjoy long rides without discomfort. Plus, the electric motor gives you peace of mind, ensuring you have the extra boost you need whenever fatigue sets in.

Whether you're commuting, running errands, or simply enjoying the fresh air, the 2025 Simple Step-Thru 500 watt Hybrid Electric Bike is built to give you the most comfortable, stress-free, and enjoyable riding experience yet.

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Labs
